title: disappointing and not worth the money
text: disappointing and not worth the money. I was disappointed in this product.  For the price I don't feel like the quality is as high as it should be, if it cost 1/2 the price I'd be more in line.  The flat surface is nice but it's not really adjustable, you have to put in little screws to hold it at a given width, meaning any time you might want to adjust it you have to take out at least 4 screws and re-screw them in (and who knows how many times you could do that).  So it's really a fixed with that you can customize.  That said it also felt way to flimsy when stretched out at wide as I would have liked it and the bottom is not flat (in the middle will be lower unless you use it in the smallest possible configuration).  The worst part though is the wheels, they are awful and don't move well at all. I'm going to have to spend more $ to buy better castors and try to attach those instead because these are bad enough that it's almost a stationary thing.  It does look nice and higher end than the wire shelves, and the handle is nice but overall I was very disappointed with this product, particularly since it's not cheap.
